prior_finding_status.summary: Bridge-generated v2 records and complete runtime custody are now mandatory for the exact 16-cell capture; synthetic legacy records fail closed.

failed_gates.summary: Scoring re-reads mutable response bytes after capture verification and can return a result calculated from bytes absent from the frozen capture.
The pre-key custody check does not bind the later response reads that actually influence scoring.

finding.title: Scoring can consume response bytes that are not in the frozen capture
finding.reproduction: Build and capture all 16 bridge-generated offline controls; after verify_capture_manifest returns but before score_runs reads responses, replace one response with another structurally valid closed response. score_runs returns a result bound to the old capture_root while scoring the replacement bytes.

otherwise_passed_evidence: immutable remote subject and exact 37-path artifact-only scope
all disclosed source hashes, modes, roots, and manifest entries
mandatory consumed-permit, terminal-receipt, provider-event, stderr, response, and runtime-source custody
exact fixed 16-cell bridge capture with protected adjudication patched absent
legacy synthetic, missing, duplicated, drifted, cross-root, time, usage, event, response, and permit adversaries
failure and timeout retention without retry or scorable response
minimal_repair: Before protected-key access, load and validate the exact run and response bytes into an immutable in-memory snapshot bound to the capture manifest, and score only that snapshot; add an adversary that mutates a response at the gate boundary and must fail closed.
nonclaims: This review did not launch a participant, consume a permit, or open protected adjudication.
This verdict does not authorize a call, permit release, merge, scientific claim, Protocol/Core change, Decision, authority action, or Standing effect.
